description: Four fresh random voltages on every trigger, in 2HP, with the span, the anchor and the odds all under knobs

params.text: Sets the rate of the internal trigger, from 0.0039Hz fully counter-clockwise to 1024Hz fully clockwise, and is ignored while a trigger is patched
Sets how wide a span the random values are drawn from, 0V for one fixed voltage to 10V at the far right
Sets where that span falls: its centre, or its bottom or top, according to the Min/Cn/Mx setting on the menu, -10V to +10V
Weights the odds within the span: counter-clockwise favours the middle or the minimum, clockwise favours the edges or the maximum, according to the distribution mode

inputs.text: A rising edge draws four new values; with the jack empty the internal trigger does it at the knob's rate

outputs.text: One of the four random voltages, redrawn on each trigger

notes: with nothing patched into the trigger jack the module runs itself at the frequency knob's rate, so it needs no other module to work
a full turn of the distribution knob collapses the span to a single voltage; keeping it inside two thirds of its travel, or lowering the distribution range on the menu, keeps the spread
menu: Min/Center/Max-mode: Min, Center, Max — chooses whether the anchor knob sets the bottom, the middle or the top of the span
Forced-polarity (center/edge) — makes each new value land in the opposite half of the span from the one before, and is ignored in Min/Max distribution
Distibution-mode: Center/Edge, Min/Max — chooses what the two ends of the distribution knob favour
Distibution-range: 60% (value-range not affected) up to 100% — narrows what the distribution knob covers, so a full turn no longer collapses the span to one voltage
Polyphony: Auto, 1 (monophonic) up to 16 channels — sets how many independent random values each output carries
LFO rate chaos — picks a new random speed for each cycle of the internal trigger, and does nothing while a trigger is patched
Quantize mode — rounds the output to the nearest step of the size chosen, from a twelfth of a volt up to 5V, and is Off unless you set it
Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
Auto select process quality — picks the process quality from the dialled-in rate and from which ports are patched, and greys out the manual choice while it is on
Trigger-high detect-level — sets the voltage at which an incoming trigger counts as high, 1V or more unless you change it
Trigger-low detect-level — sets the voltage an incoming trigger must fall back below before the next one is counted, under 0.1V unless you change it

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads the internal trigger, at the knob's rate; a negative voltage does nothing here.
